introduction.purpose: This document specifies the functional and non-functional requirements for a project management application that enables small teams to collaborate effectively through task management, automated reminders, role-based access control, and document export capabilities.

product_scope.summary: A web-based project management application supporting task creation and tracking, team collaboration with role-based permissions, automated reminder system, and PDF export functionality for project documentation.
business_objectives: Provide an intuitive project management solution for small teams
Enable efficient team collaboration with controlled access permissions
Automate project tracking through reminder systems
Support project documentation through export capabilities
benefits: Improved team productivity through organized task management
Enhanced collaboration with controlled access permissions
Reduced missed deadlines through automated reminders
goals: Deliver a fully functional web-based project management application
Support up to 100 concurrent users at launch

product_perspective.system_context: The project management application operates as a web-based service with a responsive frontend, RESTful API backend, database storage, and integration capabilities for future expansion. The system handles user authentication, project data management, reminder scheduling, and document generation.

performance_requirements.description: The system shall support up to 100 concurrent users with response times under 2 seconds for most operations
PDF generation shall complete within 30 seconds for typical project reports
The application shall maintain availability of 99.5% during business hours
Database queries shall return results within 500 milliseconds under normal load

safety_requirements.description: The system shall prevent accidental loss of active project work.
safety_requirements.hazard: Loss of project inputs or artifacts

security_requirements.description: User authentication shall use secure password hashing with salt
All data transmission shall use TLS 1.2 or higher encryption
Role-based access control shall be enforced at all access points
User sessions shall expire after 24 hours of inactivity
Password policies shall require minimum 8 characters with complexity

software_quality_attributes.description: Non-technical users should complete the intake and answer flow without training.

business_rules.description: Administrators can create projects and assign team members
Team members can only access projects they are assigned to
Task assignments must include clear deadlines and descriptions
PDF exports must include all relevant project information
Reminders must be sent with sufficient lead time before deadlines

database_requirements.description: The database shall store user accounts, project data, task information, and permission settings
Data shall be backed up daily with point-in-time recovery capability
User passwords shall be stored using secure hashing algorithms
Database performance shall be monitored and optimized for expected load
Data retention policies shall comply with standard business practices

internationalization_requirements.description: The product should support future localization without changing the API contract.
locale_rules: ISO date formatting for API payloads

legal_requirements.description: The system shall comply with standard data protection practices for user information
User data shall be handled in accordance with general privacy principles
The application shall include terms of service and privacy policy documentation
Data export capabilities shall respect intellectual property rights

reuse_objectives.description: Reuse question planning, validation, and export modules across future agents.

additional_requirements.description: The system shall use responsive web design for compatibility with various devices
Error messages shall be clear and helpful for non-technical users
The interface shall be intuitive and require minimal training
The application shall include help documentation and user guides
Future expansion capabilities shall be considered in the architecture

The system will provide core project management capabilities including task tracking, role-based access control, automated reminders, and PDF export functionality.
